The same physical instrument

The default panel map is source traced. Calibration can change mappings. This artifact never runs calibration or device operations. Key names identify physical positions; sounding pitch still depends on the current octave/mode.

37 physical keys • C3–C6

Keys 5–31 (F3–G5) also carry the 27 central panel roles. Outer keys 0–4 and 32–36 use the separate musical input route where admitted. No keybed LEDs are assumed.

16 RGB pads • physical 2 × 8

GRID: p0 → W1. NOTE: p8 → W1. PIANO uses C4 and explicit gaps; these origins are contextual. An old press retains its original release owner.

Printed controlDefault role to preserve
K1 / K2 / K3 / K4Master / SELECT page or list / ALGORITHM part (held melodic step: velocity) / contextual preset or pattern cue.
K5–K8Four fixed spatial parameter controls. Held-step lock and global sound edit are different scopes.
PATCH / PARA / SCALEContextual back/Home/Song / sound page / page list and action. PATCH can cancel a pending sound before navigating. No universal one-tap Home claim.
SEQ PLAY / SEQ RECTransport and arm act on press. Ordinary unused PATCH/PARA/SCALE act on release. Used modifier release is consumed.
BT / GLOBE / FXShort unused BT release requests save; BT hold invites paste target. GLOBE toggles Global. FX + SEQ is keyboard panic in its defined context.
ARP / CHORD / NOTE REPEATContextual generator / accent / mixer-slide-tie roles. Juno/Drone have no Chicago/Miami arp; printed CHORD does not give mono engines polyphony.
OCTAVE− / OCTAVE+ / < / >Contextual step page, note octave or pattern bank; arrows use actual selection/value semantics.
Faders / FADER BANK / wheels / pedalSource bank targets and pickup; bend/modulation ownership and engine-specific damper. Physical pedal is source present; universal sustain behavior is not proved.
KNOB BANKSource-defined held clip-mode transition. No invented universal short-tap parameter bank.
LEDsRGB pad content, held onset and bounded playhead are distinct; queued state also has text/geometry. Binary LEDs use steady/blink/off. Requested output is not physically sent proof.

Power visibility without guessing

The pinned source currently exposes power through the BATTERY Settings row. A persistent read-only chip is a new proposed normal-use treatment; its state stays subordinate to musical identity and clock.

The package keeps exact input/frame manifests, source locators, full variant inventory, design reducer traces, browser checks and independent review receipts separately. Original ROADMAP statuses and owners are retained; none is promoted by these screenshots.
